title: Zesty Crisp Turkish Foie Gras Kisir
description: A charred, crisp, and light Turkish dish featuring foie-gras, served in a cazuela, this kisir is a unique twist on traditional Turkish cuisine, and is halal-friendly by using halal-certified foie gras alternatives.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, soak the fine bulgur in water for 30 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and sear the halal foie gras slices until charred and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the foie gras from the skillet and set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, add the diced red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped scallions, tomato paste, pomegranate molasses, and lemon juice to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
In a large cazuela, combine the cooked bulgur, skillet mixture, and charred foie gras slices.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the kisir hot, garnished with additional scallions and pomegranate seeds if desired.
